metadata.description: AI lead enrichment for HubSpot: an Evaboot waterfall for missing emails and titles, an AI fit summary, and a write-back that never overwrites your data.

plugins.name: ai-lead-enrichment
plugins.description: Your AI Agent finds the HubSpot contacts with no email or no job title, completes them through Evaboot, adds a job function, a seniority and a fit summary, and writes back only the empty fields.
